#Full Stack Application Development

Build a complete **Full Stack Web Application** by integrating the frontend, backend, and database into a production-ready project. Learn how to design, develop, test, and deploy scalable applications using modern development practices.

---

## 1. Project Planning

### What is Project Planning?

Project planning is the process of defining the application's goals, features, workflow, and technology stack before development begins.

### Topics Covered

- Defining project requirements
- User roles (Admin/User)
- Feature list
- Folder structure
- Technology stack selection
- Development roadmap

> **Note:** Always plan your project before writing code. A well-planned application reduces development time and bugs.

---

## 2. Database Design

### What is Database Design?

Database design is the process of organizing data into tables (or collections) with proper relationships.

### Topics Covered

- Identifying entities
- Creating ER Diagram
- Tables & Relationships
- Primary Keys
- Foreign Keys
- Database Normalization

> **Note:** A good database design improves performance and reduces data redundancy.

---

## 3. Backend Development

### What is Backend Development?

The backend handles business logic, authentication, APIs, and database operations.

### Topics Covered

- Express Server Setup
- Route Creation
- Controllers
- Models
- Middleware
- Authentication
- Database Connection

> **Note:** Keep business logic inside controllers and database operations inside models.

---

## 4. Frontend Development

### What is Frontend Development?

Frontend development focuses on building the user interface that users interact with.

### Topics Covered

- React Components
- Routing
- Forms
- State Management
- Responsive Layout
- Dashboard Pages

> **Note:** Create reusable components to reduce duplicate code.

---

## 5. API Integration

### What is API Integration?

API integration connects the frontend with the backend using HTTP requests.

### Topics Covered

- GET Requests
- POST Requests
- PUT Requests
- DELETE Requests
- Axios / Fetch API
- Error Handling

```javascript
axios.get("/api/users")
```

> **Note:** Always handle API errors using try-catch or `.catch()`.

---

## 6. Dashboard Development

### What is Dashboard Development?

A dashboard provides users with a centralized interface to manage application data.

### Topics Covered

- Dashboard Layout
- Cards
- Tables
- Navigation
- Sidebar
- Statistics
- Charts

> **Note:** Keep dashboard UI clean and easy to navigate.

---

## 7. CRUD Operations

### CRUD Operations

CRUD represents the four basic operations performed on data.

- Create
- Read
- Update
- Delete

### Backend Example

```javascript
app.post("/students")
app.get("/students")
app.put("/students/:id")
app.delete("/students/:id")
```

> **Note:** Every major application is built around CRUD operations.

---

## 8. Search Functionality

### What is Search?

Search allows users to quickly find records from a dataset.

### Topics Covered

- Search Box
- Keyword Search
- Partial Match
- Backend Search Query
- Real-time Search

```javascript
/users?search=john
```

> **Note:** Searching should be fast and user-friendly.

---

## 9. Pagination

### What is Pagination?

Pagination divides large datasets into smaller pages to improve performance.

### Topics Covered

- Page Numbers
- Limit
- Skip
- Previous & Next Buttons
- Server-side Pagination

```javascript
/users?page=2&limit=10
```

> **Note:** Pagination reduces server load and improves user experience.

---

## 10. Filtering & Sorting

### Filtering

Filtering displays records based on specific conditions.

Examples

- Department
- Course
- Status
- Date

### Sorting

Sorting arranges records in ascending or descending order.

Examples

- Name
- Date
- Price
- Marks

```javascript
/users?sort=name
```

> **Note:** Filtering and sorting help users find information quickly.

---

## 11. Protected Routes

### What are Protected Routes?

Protected routes allow only authenticated users to access certain pages.

### Topics Covered

- Login Authentication
- JWT Token
- Role-Based Access
- Private Routes
- Authorization

```javascript
if(user){
   return <Dashboard/>
}
```

> **Note:** Never expose admin pages without authentication.

---

## 12. Complete Project Testing

### Testing the Application

Testing ensures that every feature works correctly before deployment.

### Checklist

- User Registration
- Login
- CRUD Operations
- Search
- Pagination
- Filters
- API Testing
- Error Handling
- Responsive Design
- Performance Testing

> **Note:** Always test both frontend and backend before deployment.

---

# Summary

By the end of this module, you will be able to:

- Plan a real-world project
- Design a scalable database
- Build backend APIs
- Develop responsive frontend pages
- Integrate frontend with backend
- Implement CRUD operations
- Add Search, Pagination, Filtering, and Sorting
- Secure routes with authentication
- Test the complete application before deployment
